label: exact-old-token-member-and-changed-value
sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM
 (SELECT source_system,rel_type_id,id,props_json FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.edge_current VERSION AS OF 2
 WHERE entity_version=1 AND apply_batch_id='r89' AND pmod(id,8)>=4) b
 FULL OUTER JOIN client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.publication_stage_r94 VERSION AS OF 0 s
 ON b.source_system=s.source_system AND b.rel_type_id=s.rel_type_id AND b.id=s.id
 WHERE b.id IS NULL OR s.id IS NULL OR instr(b.props_json,concat('"105":',s.old_json))=0
 OR s.old_json=concat('"',get_json_object(s.props_json,'$.105'),'"')
